author: Ogrey
body:
Special map built for Flufflepuff_, Happy Valentine's Day! <3



Map Name: Zao II
Map Creators: Astronis
Map Helpers: FlufflesSub
Map Gamemode: Nebula OiTN
Info:
- 1 hit kill weapons! (OiTN)
- First OiTN map with 4 teams!
- Two layers to play on! Upper and Bottom!
- Two different spawnpoints!
- No fall damage!
- Sequel to Zao! (which may or may not break soon after I change its name to Zao I!)
